questions.question: Why did the Philistine commanders send David away before the battle?
options: They needed him to guard the supply camp
They feared he would turn against them in battle
They suspected that he was secretly spying for King Saul
They thought him too weak to fight well
questions.answer: They feared he would turn against them in battle

questions.question: How did Achish regard David?
options: As blameless, like an angel of God
As a spy sent to betray the army
As a fool unfit for the battle
As a dangerous enemy to be watched
questions.answer: As blameless, like an angel of God

questions.question: David was spared from having to fight against Israel.
The Philistine _____ did not trust David and sent him back.
Achish said David was as blameless as an _____ of God.
